changes_reviewed: Linux fork copy-on-write uses a private replay of all acquired frames, no Open3D shallow copy; child cannot modify parent native or prediction volume.
120-second computational child timeout or child failure retries identical complete fresh replay, no route skipped or policy stop.
Native-ray cache stores only t_hit for SHA of identical ray array within a fixed immutable native scene; pixelwise equality reproduced against original renderer.
Shared full posterior including tiny positive mass, raw 0.22m quadrature, ordered repeated future frames preserved.
Only two short scripted prefixes overridden using cost-only predeclared amendment; full cold-start loop uses no short prefix override.
Short final three contain both S winners from cost pool and all four conditions rerank only these actual branches; full loop uses native complete candidates.
limitations: Prior independent fork review predates addition of timeout fallback; current helper and forced-timeout receipt are explicitly bound here.
Correctness checks establish implementation equivalence of computation backends; they do not establish experimental benefit.
Exact depth and fusion remain computationally expensive; run timings under concurrency are not isolated realtime benchmarks.
